tasks.prompt: Find the production predator hunting AI implementation and explain where predator hunt eligibility and dodge behavior are defined.
Trace how predator hunting behavior is defined and then integrated into the live Rush gameplay scene. Identify the core files and their responsibilities.
If predator pressure positioning changes, identify the module that calculates pressure slots and the gameplay scene that uses those calculations. Explain the direct relationship.
Trace the Apex Hunt feature from its target/state implementation to the Rush scene integration. Identify the participating production files and responsibilities.
Find how Rush spawn scheduling is implemented and where the active gameplay scene constructs or consumes that scheduler.
Trace the production transition from a finished Rush result to the cleaning sequence. Identify the files responsible for result completion and cleaning initialization.
Trace how finishing aquarium cleaning applies progression. Identify the cleaning scene and the production module that applies the end-of-cleaning progression.
Before adding a new aquarium-cleaning tool, identify the production scene that owns tool lifecycle and the tool interface it consumes. Explain why both need inspection.
Before adjusting predator-dodge feedback without changing spawning, identify the AI behavior module, the pressure/coordinator module, and the Rush gameplay integration point. Explain each scope.
Find the production game startup implementation and explain where the game services are constructed and scenes are registered.
